title: 10 Stocks Lost Over 40% in 2026 as Investors Dumped Everything AI Might Kill
excerpt: The S&P 500 rose 8% in 2026, but its 10 worst stocks lost over 40%. AI fears explain some of it, not all. Here is what happened
content_html:
The S&P 500 rose 8.28% this year. However, ten of its own stocks lost more than 40%.

Both things are true at once. Investors are paying almost anything for AI. They are dumping whatever they think AI will kill.

AI Fear Crushed Software and Consulting Stocks

The damage is concentrated. Software, consulting and advertising names fill the bottom of the Slickcharts list.

It started in February. Anthropic released a new AI model. Enterprise software stocks sold off hard. Traders called it the SaaS-pocalypse.

Intuit (INTU) is the clearest victim, down 55.27%. It owns TurboTax, which brings in about a quarter of company revenue and profit.

Then cheap AI tax tools arrived. Goldman Sachs analyst Gabriela Borges cut her price target in June to $276, down from $519.

Intuit moved fast. It cut 17% of staff, roughly 3,000 jobs. It also lowered its TurboTax forecast.

The company is now worth about $88 billion, Forbes reported. A year earlier it was worth more than $219 billion.

Accenture (ACN) tells a similar story, down 45.21%. Clients are spending on AI instead of consultants.

New client orders slipped to $19.3 billion from $19.7 billion. Accenture cut its sales growth forecast to between 3% and 4%. The stock fell almost 18% in one day.

Cognizant (CTSH), Gartner (IT) and The Trade Desk (TTD) each lost 44% to 55%. All three sell work that AI can copy.

But the Two Biggest Losers Had Nothing to do with AI

Here is the twist. The two worst stocks fell for old-fashioned reasons.

CoStar Group (CSGP) is down 58.86%, the weakest in the index. Its problem is spending, not AI.

CoStar owns Homes.com, a property listings site. In January it said the site will not cover its own costs until 2029. Profit is not expected until 2030.

The core business is fine. Revenue jumped 23% to $897 million last quarter. Profit was just $3 million.

Investors lost patience. In February, hedge fund D.E. Shaw told CoStar to quit or shrink Homes.com. It said the move could unlock more than $10 billion. CoStar called the campaign "activism malpractice."

Shareholders backed the board in June. Nasdaq had already dropped the stock from its Nasdaq-100 index in May.

Boston Scientific (BSX) is down 53.59%. It simply grew slower than promised.

In February it expected sales to grow 10% to 11%. By April it cut that to between 6.5% and 8%.

A rival explains why. Medtronic said its heart device sales rose 124% in the United States. It took "an additional 8 points of U.S. share."

Then bad news piled up. Boston Scientific recalled its Accolade pacemakers. Regulators tied the fault to four deaths and 2,557 serious injuries. It also agreed to buy Penumbra for $14.5 billion.

人工智能恐惧压垮了软件和咨询公司的股票

伤害集中。 软件、咨询和广告名称占据了 Slickcharts 列表的底部。

事情从二月份开始。 Anthropic发布了新的AI模型。 企业软件股遭遇大幅抛售。 交易员称其为“SaaS 末日”。

Intuit (INTU) 是最明显的受害者，下跌 55.27%。 它拥有 TurboTax，该公司约占公司收入和利润的四分之一。

然后廉价的人工智能税务工具出现了。 高盛分析师 Gabriela Borges 将 6 月份的目标股价从 519 美元下调至 276 美元。

Intuit 行动迅速。 它裁减了 17% 的员工，大约 3,000 个工作岗位。 它还降低了 TurboTax 预测。

据《福布斯》报道，该公司目前估值约为 880 亿美元。 一年前，它的价值超过 2190 亿美元。

埃森哲 (ACN) 也讲述了类似的故事，下跌 45.21%。 客户把钱花在人工智能上，而不是顾问身上。

新客户订单从 197 亿美元下滑至 193 亿美元。 埃森哲将销售增长预期下调至 3% 至 4%。 该股一日内下跌近18%。

Cognizant (CTSH)、Gartner (IT) 和 The Trade Desk (TTD) 分别下跌 44% 至 55%。 这三者都出售人工智能可以复制的作品。

但两个最大的输家与人工智能无关

这是一个转折点。 两只表现最差的股票因老生常谈的原因而下跌。

CoStar Group (CSGP) 下跌 58.86%，是该指数中表现最弱的。 它的问题在于支出，而不是人工智能。

CoStar 拥有 Homes.com，这是一个房产列表网站。 1 月份，该公司表示，该网站在 2029 年之前不会承担自己的成本。 预计到 2030 年才能盈利。

核心业务还好。 上季度收入增长 23% 至 8.97 亿美元。 利润仅为 300 万美元。

投资者失去了耐心。 2 月，对冲基金 D.E. Shaw 告诉 CoStar 退出或缩减 Homes.com。 该公司表示，此举可能释放超过 100 亿美元的资金。 CoStar 称该活动为“激进主义弊端”。

股东在六月份支持了董事会。 纳斯达克已于 5 月份将该股从纳斯达克 100 指数中剔除。

波士顿科学公司 (BSX) 下跌 53.59%。 它只是增长速度比承诺的要慢。

2 月份预计销售额将增长 10% 至 11%。 到 4 月份，该比例已降至 6.5% 至 8% 之间。

一位竞争对手解释了原因。 美敦力 (Medtronic) 表示，其心脏设备在美国的销售额增长了 124%。 它“增加了美国市场份额 8 个百分点”。

随后坏消息接踵而至。 波士顿科学公司 (Boston Scientific) 召回其 Accolade 起搏器。 监管机构认定该故障导致 4 人死亡和 2,557 人重伤。 它还同意以 145 亿美元收购 Penumbra。
